title: Genome-Wide Analysis of Wheat GATA Transcription Factor Genes Reveals Their Molecular Evolutionary Characteristics and Involvement in Salt and Drought Tolerance.
authors: Du, Xuan; Lu, Yuxia; Sun, Haocheng; Duan, Wenjing; Hu, Yingkao; Yan, Yueming
one_liner_zh: 全基因组鉴定小麦GATA转录因子家族并分析其进化与胁迫响应，仅含少量蛋白-DNA对接，缺乏AI/物理模拟方法，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: GATA transcription factor genes participate in plant growth, development, morphogenesis, and stress response. In this study, we carried out a comprehensive genome-wide analysis of wheat GATA transcription factor genes to reveal their molecular evolutionary characteristics and involvement in salt and drought tolerance. In total, 79 TaGATA genes containing a conserved GATA domain were identified in the wheat genome, which were classified into four subfamilies. Collinear analysis indicated that fragment duplication plays an important role in the amplification of the wheat GATA gene family. Functional disproportionation analysis between subfamilies found that both type I and type II functional divergence simultaneously occurs in wheat GATA genes, which might result in functional differentiation of the TaGATA gene family. Transcriptional expression analysis showed that TaGATA genes generally have a high expression level in leaves and in response to drought and salt stresses. Overexpression of TaGATA62 and TaGATA73 genes significantly enhanced the drought and salt tolerance of yeast and Arabidopsis. Protein-protein docking indicated that TaGATAs can enhance drought and salt tolerance by interacting between the DNA-binding motif of GATA transcription factors and photomorphogenesis-related protein TaCOP9-5A. Our results provided a base for further understanding the molecular evolution and functional characterization of the plant GATA gene family in response to abiotic stresses.
abstract_zh: GATA转录因子基因参与植物生长、发育、形态建成及胁迫响应。本研究对小麦GATA转录因子基因进行了全基因组水平的综合分析，以揭示其分子进化特征及其在耐盐和耐旱性中的作用。在小麦基因组中共鉴定出79个含有保守GATA结构域的TaGATA基因，并将其划分为四个亚家族。共线性分析表明，片段重复在小麦GATA基因家族的扩增中发挥重要作用。亚家族间的功能分化分析发现，I型和II型功能分歧同时发生在小麦GATA基因中，这可能导致TaGATA基因家族的功能分化。转录表达分析显示，TaGATA基因通常在叶片中具有高表达水平，并对干旱和盐胁迫产生响应。TaGATA62和TaGATA73基因的过表达显著增强了酵母和拟南芥的耐旱性和耐盐性。蛋白质-蛋白质对接表明，TaGATAs可通过GATA转录因子的DNA结合基序与光形态建成相关蛋白TaCOP9-5A之间的相互作用来增强耐旱和耐盐性。我们的结果为进一步理解植物GATA基因家族在非生物胁迫响应中的分子进化和功能特征提供了基础。
